name: Fillit 4000mAh LED Mirror Power Bank
description:
Stylish 2-in-1 LED mirror aur portable power bank. Is mein 32 LED lights, compact design aur mobile charging ki sahulat hai. Travel, makeup aur daily use ke liye convenient choice.
Key Features:
4000mAh capacity (packaging ke mutabiq)
32 LED lights
Built-in mirror
Portable, lightweight design
